description: Jamo's World-style sharpness gauge (core/interface/world_sharpness/), from Jamo's mod "MH4U MH4G World Style Sharpness Indicator" v1.1, used with Jamo's permission: Mod Settings > Interface > World Sharpness. The numbers are the mod's, read from its files and its code.

colours.description: The bar's colour at each sharpness level, red to purple (RGB): the mod's animation ui202_slash, whose seven animations colour the bar ui202_color00, one per level.

alpha.description: The bar's alpha, steady: the game's animation pulses it between 200 and 100 over 80 frames; the mod keeps it at 200.

frame_tint.description: The colour the three frames of the gauge (ui202_kire00..02, white in the game's layout) are drawn with (RGB, the texture times it): the mod darkened their pixels in the texture qst00_ID; this tint gives the game's picture (an HD pack's too) nearly the mod's look (0.71 of the light: on the mod's frames' pixels a mean difference of 12 in 255).

slide.description: How far the bar's x moves for a change of its scale, times its width: Jamo's code's constant, which keeps the bar's left end in the frame as it shrinks.
